title: Sprite animation on the map (as in flickering fire etc)

posts.author: PhiSt
posts.body: So i've downloaded a tileset that includes character images for events, including lanterns and the like. These have 3 variations respectively. I'm trying to use set movement route for this event to change the image to the respective image next to it, but when i go to select it, the white image selection box is way to large and no matter what i do, it always selects the image at the top right corner. Does anyone have any solutions?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Sounds like the images you downloaded are not correctly formatted for RPG Maker character sheets (or the naming is incorrect).
You can see the description of the correct format in your instructions: Help -> Contents -> Documentation -> Asset Standards
You may have to use an image editor to rearrange the cels.
If you need more help, provide a link to the tileset in question (if it's a paid one, show us a picture of the character sheet with some watermarking or something over it).

Well...unless the screenshot you posted isn't actually the image, it's not fine
According to MZ's specifications, a character sheet is 12 x 8 cels. Dividing the image you posted by those numbers, we come up with a cel size of 90 x 135.
I've turned on GIMP's grid at that size for the picture below, and as you can see
1 - none of the images are centered in their cel, and most are overlapping into another.
2 - The images of a similar item (e.g. the three lit fires) aren't in the first three cels to be grouped as one character.
But if you managed to get something, then that's fine for you.
Good luck with your project.
